bio.text: Greg Howard, a Republican, represents the 43rd Assembly District, covering Stonington, North Stonington and Ledyard, and is the lead House Republican on the Public Safety and Security Committee.
He began his public service career in 1995 with the Westerly Ambulance Corps and worked in EMS for 26 years, retiring from that field in 2021.
He has been employed by the Stonington Police Department since 2002 and is currently a detective.
He was born and raised in Westerly, Rhode Island, and has lived in Pawcatuck, Connecticut, since 2003.
